approval_event.storage: EXTEND site00_client_review_receipts (+ events) — add family_id, authority_id, version_label, previous_status, new_status, revision_reason, comment; no third review store

transitions.then: family N+1 → READY_TO_BEGIN if no funding needed, else AWAITING_PRODUCTION_FUNDING

transitions.when: funding confirmed (provider connected + sufficient attested balance, or prepayment received)

gate_machine.bridge: Approval service writes site00_project_deliverables.status = CLIENT_APPROVED so existing dependencyEngine/readinessEvaluator gates unlock (they already key on CLIENT_APPROVED).

approval_vs_funding_separation: APPROVE never shows prices or payment controls. Funding appears AFTER approval as the next step (NextFamilyAdvance). Copy never implies "approve or pay".
client_never_runs_production: No GENERATE / RUN AGENT / START JOB / DEPLOY in the client app. Client may only APPROVE and FUND / CONFIRM; production advances via founder/system.
